title: Saba Sirna Uumamaa Morme
intro: Naannoo seenaan isaa baroota darbanii sagalee dhageessisu keessatti hawaasni tokko seera qulqullinaa irratti fincila ifa ta’een jiraachaa ture. Hojiin isaanii kun kan kanaan dura hin argamne waan ta’eef, dhala namaa hundaaf akeekkachiisa ta’anii yaadatamu. Lubbuuwwan kun eenyu turan, hiree akkamii isaan mudate?
clues: Lafa karaa imaltoonni yeroo baayʼee keessa darban keessa jiraanna turre, garuu imala isaanii balaa akka taʼu gooneerra.
Gocha safuu akkasii kan kanaan dura addunyaalee irratti namni tokkollee hojjetee hin beekne raawwanne.
Ergamaan nu keessaa karaa keenya akka dhiifnu nu waame, nuti garuu isa dinnee yoo dhugaa dubbate adabbii gaafanne.
Keessummoonni bareedoon gara magaalaa keenyaa yommuu dhufan, ergamtoota badiisaa ta’uu isaanii osoo hin beekin isaan rukutuuf barbaanne.
Yoo ofirraa hin dhiisne adabbii hamaa akka nurra gahu akeekkachiifamne, garuu akeekkachiisa sanatti qoosnee cubbuu keenya keessa turre.
Roobni dhagaa samii irraa nutti roobe, manni keenyas garagalfamee, warra calaqqisaniif mallattoo malee aarsaa tokkollee hin hafne.

arabic: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient." (29:34)
